s12-assign-cookies.trick: Sort children by greed and cookies by size. Give the smallest sufficient cookie to the least greedy unserved child.
s12-assign-cookies.time: O(g log g + s log s)

s12-fractional-knapsack-problem.trick: Sort items by value-to-weight ratio descending. Take each whole item while possible, then the needed fraction of the next one.

s12-greedy-algorithm-to-find-minimum-num.trick: For the standard Indian denomination set, take as many as possible of each coin from largest to smallest. This greedy rule is not valid for arbitrary coin systems.
s12-greedy-algorithm-to-find-minimum-num.time: O(d + c), d denominations and c coins returned

s12-lemonade-change.trick: Track $5 and $10 notes. For a $20 payment, prefer giving one $10 and one $5, preserving $5 notes for later customers.

s12-valid-paranthesis-checker.trick: For a string with '(' , ')' and '*', track the minimum and maximum possible open counts. '*' may be ')', '(' or empty.

s12-n-meetings-in-one-room.trick: Sort meetings by finish time. Taking the earliest finishing compatible meeting leaves the most room for later meetings.

s12-jump-game.trick: Scan left to right while tracking the farthest reachable index. If the current index exceeds that reach, the end is impossible.

s12-jump-game-2.trick: Treat all positions reachable with the current number of jumps as one layer. When the scan reaches the layer's end, take another jump to the farthest next reach.

s12-minimum-number-of-platforms-required.trick: Sort arrival and departure times separately. Sweep chronologically, increasing platforms for an arrival and freeing one for a departure.

s12-job-sequencing-problem.trick: Process jobs by descending profit. Assign each to its latest free slot at or before its deadline; disjoint-set links occupied slots to the next earlier free one.

s12-candy.trick: Give every child one candy. A left-to-right pass satisfies higher ratings than the left neighbor; a right-to-left pass satisfies the right neighbor.

s12-program-for-shortest-job-first-or-sj.trick: When all jobs are ready at time zero, running shorter jobs first minimizes total waiting time. Add each job's start time to the waiting total.

s12-program-for-least-recently-used-lru-.trick: Keep recent pages in a list and their positions in a hash map. A hit moves its page to the front; a miss evicts the oldest page if full.

s12-insert-interval.trick: With sorted non-overlapping intervals, copy those entirely before the new one, merge every overlap into it, then append the rest.

s12-merge-intervals.trick: Sort intervals by start. The last output interval either absorbs the next overlapping interval or stays separate.

s12-non-overlapping-intervals.trick: Sort by ending time and keep each interval that starts at or after the previous chosen end. All skipped intervals must be removed.
